newsitem.title: USA: U.S. MTBE barrels ahead on production problems.
newsitem.headline: U.S. MTBE barrels ahead on production problems.

text.p: U.S. spot MTBE prices barreled ahead this week in light activity following temporary production problems in the Gulf Coast, players said Thursday.
Traders, however, blew a bearish tune for the gasoline additive next week with the return of production and exports coming from abroad.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, prompt Houston MTBE soared two cents a gallon to between 77.50 cents and 78.00 cents a gallon. Parcels for 77.75 cents were heard done Thursday.
Values firmed on the back of production problems late last week that have since been fixed at Texas Petrochemicals Corp and Global Octane.
"I expect prices to come back down. Both of those plants are back up," said a Houston trader.
Four ships were also loading MTBE in the Gulf to bring material to the tighter-supplied New York Harbor hub. Of the four ships, only one is expected to arrive on the East Coast before June.
In the Harbor, spot MTBE was up two cents at 81.50/82.25 cents. -- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
